cases.label: reject
cases.note: A recurrence library has no startup event and should reject.

cases.label: empty
cases.note: Parse successfully and yield no occurrences.

cases.label: error-at-iteration
cases.note: Parse successfully, raise on first iteration.

expectation.note: crontab(5) defines @reboot only in terms of the daemon's lifecycle, so a pure recurrence engine has no correct answer.

rationale: @reboot is the clearest case in the corpus where the expression language names something outside the recurrence model. Recording three admissible answers is more useful than legislating one.
title: @reboot (an event, not a recurrence)
